```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Load necessary libraries and set global options
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(cluster)       # For clustering
library(factoextra)    # For visualizing clusters
library(ggplot2)       # For data visualization
```

# Introduction
Project Goal: 
    The project goal is to identify distinct team archetypes 
    for college basketball by using clustering based on offensive and defensive 
    metrics. We will then aim to analyze how archetype combinations perform 
    against each other in different matchups.

## Data Collection
```{r data-collection}
data <- read.csv("./CBB-Project/src/data/merged_data.csv", na.strings = c("NULL", "NA"))
head(data)
```

## Data Cleaning
```{r data-cleaning}

```

# Feature Selection
```{r feature-selection}
features <- data %>%
    # Select all columns from the dataset
    select(everything())

features <- data %>%
  select(tempo_adj, off_eff_adj, def_eff_adj, pos_len_off, pos_len_def) %>%
  drop_na()
features_scaled <- scale(features)
head(features_scaled)
```

# Exploratory Data Analysis
```{r eda}
# Summary statistics
summary(features)

# Correlation matrix
cor_matrix <- cor(features)
print(cor_matrix)

# Visualize distributions
features_long <- features %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "feature", values_to = "value")

ggplot(features_long, aes(x = value)) +
  facet_wrap(~feature, scales = "free") +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "steelblue", color = "white") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Feature Distributions")

# Pairwise scatterplots
pairs(features, main = "Scatterplot Matrix of Features")
```
